Spawns particles along live letter fronts. rate is fractional — the accumulator pattern (spawn whole particles, keep the remainder in t-space implicitly by probabilistic gating) keeps density steady without a second counter. Emissions come only from columns that carry glyph ink and whose letter front is mid-flight, so embers pour off burning edges — never out of the spaces between letters.

Burn sessions (dir +1) emit AT the front with upward velocity — the classic rising-ember look. Rebuild sessions (dir −1) instead seed the still-empty zone ABOVE the front and launch downward: deposits rain top→bottom and land on the climbing edge, knitting the glyphs back.
